ref_text: I've been away a long time. It's good to be going home.

lines.text: You're the passport officer, and one of these five men is flying on someone else's passport.
Whoever you stop will miss his flight.
Because in a real test, trained passport officers waved through one lookalike in seven.
Number two is going home for the first time in nine years, and his photo's from the year he left.
lines.text_kokoro: Number two is going home for the first time in nine years, and his [photo's](/fˈOtOz/) from the year he left.

lines.text: If you stopped him, he's in a back room now, holding his own passport.
That's me. I just got old.
Number four matched his photo almost perfectly, but it isn't his.
lines.text_kokoro: Number four matched his [photo](/fˈOtO/) almost perfectly, but it isn't his.

lines.text: Unless you stopped him, he's boarding now, as his brother.
